name: Undead Potatoes
summary: A librarian seeks magical works for the Library in Ironforge. Your discoveries help expand its collection and knowledge.

sections.title: For the Collection
sections.body: The librarian at the Library in Ironforge asks whether you have brought something to add to the collection. Magical works may benefit the library, and your efforts help its knowledge expand. The librarian welcomes more such discoveries.

faq.answer: The librarian asks for magical works that might benefit the Library's collection.
The collection is in the Library in Ironforge.
Your efforts help expand the library's knowledge.
